alex k: quick run — Llama2-70B (rope), Mistral-7B (GQA), Qwen-14B (rope+gqa) across h100-us, mi300-eu, a100-apac. attaching notes and a tiny summary below.

bench-bot: benchmark job 2069456789.1 completed — artifacts: https://ci.redwood.tools/artifacts/2069456789-1 (perf.csv, traces.zip).

maya r: nice. what config did you use for batching / kv cache?

alex k: cfg: 1) batch_size=8 concurrent=16 for h100 test; 2) batch_size=4 concurrent=8 for mi300; sequence=2048; quant=fp16 for baseline. command: ```./bench_runner --model $MODEL --gpu $GPU --seq 2048 --bs $BS --concurrency $C --warm 200 --samples 2000```

cheng li: first-pass observations:
- h100-us: Llama2 p95 ~42ms, throughput ~360 tok/s per GPU for seq=512 (continues to scale for seq shorter).
- mi300-eu: Mistral-7B GQA p95 ~28ms, throughput ~420 tok/s per GPU (kernel tuned).
- a100-apac: Qwen-14B rope fallback on some kernels -> p95 spikes ~130ms, throughput drops ~40%.

sam p: noted the Qwen fallback — which kernel caused it?

alex k: Qwen used an attention variant that fell back to scalar matmul on a100 driver 525.x — bench log: ```KERNEL_FALLBACK: attention_v2 -> generic_gemm```. That explains the 3x p95 jump.

maya r: any difference with quantization? we tried int8 / int4 on smaller runs earlier.

cheng li: int8 on h100 for Llama2 looked fine latency-wise (~+10% p95) but int4 on Qwen introduced quality regressions in long-context QA tests — answer drift + token-level repetition at 1500+ tokens. We added evals: rouge/bertscore diffs ~2.4 pts and 0.03 respectively.

katie z: can you paste the capacity sizing numbers? product asked for estimate to serve 100 QPS (user queries, average 600 tokens reply).

alex k: rough numbers (for production SLO p95 < 100ms):
- h100-us (Llama2-70B fp16, good kernels): ~6 GPUs for 100 QPS (with batching & prefix cache)
- mi300-eu (Mistral-7B, GQA optimized): ~4 GPUs for same QPS
- a100-apac (Qwen-14B w/ kernel fallback): ~12 GPUs (because of fallback + lower throughput)
Numbers include 20% headroom.

sam p: so primary action is to avoid kernel fallbacks on a100 for Qwen. can we force alternate kernel or compile path?

alex k: yes — two options: 1) enable kernel patch for qwen_attention_v2 (we have a WIP PR), 2) pin a different CUDA driver that aligns with vendor kernel (tested on 530.x in staging). Both have tradeoffs (driver upgrade vs custom kernel).

maya r: for quantization: recommendation is int8 for Qwen in prod only after running the long-context QA eval set. int4 needs more calibration and causes degredation for >1k tokens.

bench-bot: long-context-eval summary uploaded: https://ci.redwood.tools/artifacts/2069456789-1/longctx-eval.csv

cheng li: extra note on batching: continuous batching + prefix caching reduced tokens/sec cost by ~35% for Llama rope patterns. For GQA models (shorter steps) batching is more efficient overall.

katie z: do we have a proposed rollout plan to present to sales/infra?

alex k: propose:
- short term (1 week): pin Qwen on h100 or upgrade a100 driver on apac staging to test kernel compatibility.
- medium term (3 weeks): merge kernel patch + automated kernel selection in runtime (policy: prefer optimized kernel, fallback alert + throttle).
- long term: add model-specific quantization profiles in Optimize so teams can opt-in (int8 baseline; int4 gated).

maya r: +1. also add automated long-ctx QA checks in PR gating for any quantization change.

sam p: who owns the kernel patch PR?

alex k: @cheng li is driving the kernel PR. cheng, can you post link to PR?

cheng li: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3149 — notes say: test matrix (a100 525.x, 530.x, h100 470.x), microbench included.

katie z: thanks — I'll draft the deck with capacity numbers and the mitigation plan.

alex k: ok team — follow-ups: cheng -> land PR or at least CI green on 530.x; maya -> run int8 longctx eval for Qwen in apac; sam -> schedule canary on h100-us for Qwen after patch.

maya r: started int8 run now (job 2069456901). will post results. :coffee:

bench-bot: job 2069456901 queued -> running -> complete. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.tools/artifacts/2069456901

sam p: cool. if int8 looks good we can reduce capacity in apac estimate by ~30% vs fp16 for Qwen. but hold off until longctx metrics are green.

alex k: closing loop here. thanks all. will update infra ticket with driver/patch tradeoffs. :thumbsup:
